_meta.purpose: Reporting-only thresholds for Rung 8 family classification and taxonomy diagnostics. This file governs how scripts/family_transfer.py LABELS families and shapes the minimal-panel tie-break — it never touches the scientific proof standard (acceptance, nulls, alpha, OOS, viability live in config/contract/* and are frozen). Editing this file changes only the report's labels, not who survived the null. Kept out of contract_hash by design.
_meta.governs: family status labels, taxonomy suggestions, minimal-panel tie-break order
_meta.does_not_govern: acceptance statistic, null pass condition, alpha, permutations, OOS boundary, viability floor

family_status._note_panel_stable: A retained family is PANEL_STABLE only if its retained arms appear on at least this many distinct assets; otherwise ASSET_CONDITIONAL. Two is 'more than one independent asset', per the semantics.

taxonomy._note: REVIEW_SPLIT when a wide family switches its representative more than half the time or shows opposite-sign confirmation deltas; REVIEW_MERGE when two families overlap in chosen representatives above the merge threshold; KEEP otherwise; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when there is not enough measured evidence.

minimal_panel._note: Set-cover tie-break, applied in this order. Deterministic; family_name is the final total order.
